name: Adhafera
description: A star 84 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, measured from its light.

radius.source: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 50335: radius 10.485 solar radii, implied by the fitted luminosity 223.103 solar luminosities (fractional uncertainty 0.036) and temperature

temperature.source: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 50335: effective temperature 6894 +/- 125 K, from the fit of a model atmosphere to the star's spectral energy distribution (goodness of fit Q 0.024)

gravity.source: SIMBAD's compilation of spectroscopic measurements (mesFe_h): log g 3.12 from 2014ApJ...791...58A, the median of its 4 spectra; the 5 published values span log g 2.91 to 3.12, across which the limb law changes by at most 0.6% of the centre brightness

distance.source: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 50335: distance 84.034 pc, the paper's parallax inverted (Gaia DR1's where it revised the star's, else the Hipparcos reduction of van Leeuwen 2007; section 2.3; fractional uncertainty 0.015), at which the luminosity and radius hold

text.card: A star 84 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, measured from its light.
text.introduction: Its brightness, measured band by band, gives 223 times the Sun's luminosity at 6,894 K, so 10.485 solar radii.
text.locator: Table 2, HIP 50335: D, Teff, L, Rad, Q

quotes.title: Zeta Leonis
quotes.card: Zeta Leonis, also named Adhafera, is a third-magnitude star in the constellation of Leo, the lion.
quotes.introduction: It forms the second star in the blade of the sickle, which is an asterism formed from the head of Leo.
